oracle: Initialize uint32 state 0x12345678; for each item apply xorshift32 shifts 13,-17,5 with uint32 wrapping, sum Python int.bit_count(), multiply by rounds. Wave3 tree oracle comes from its retained reviewed record.
timing_scope: whole process, including launch/loader/exit; not startup-subtracted historical Wave3 timings
reanalysis: All original captures and timing pairs reused, with paired aggregation added after exploratory measurement; no held-out accuracy claim.
limits: Single i7-12700H CPU10 on a shared host; selected cases include a known regression; five of seven controlled-run cases remain uncertain. No global frequency policy modified.
